name: aura-ev-intelligence-poc
description: Local PoC for AURA, an EV telemetry intelligence platform.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:node && npm run setup:python
scripts.setup:node: npm --prefix services/ingest install && npm --prefix services/web install
scripts.setup:python: py -3.11 -m venv .venv && .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r services/api/requirements.txt && .\.venv\Scripts\python services/api/scripts/train_models.py
scripts.start: concurrently -n db,ingest,api,web,sim -c gray,cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm run db" "npm run ingest" "npm run api" "npm run web" "npm run sim"
